Name: Magical Valley Interface but for some other mods
Author: K1N0K0SSUP3RGAY
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Do you despise when your UI is so pretty but mods dont have support for it? tired of being irritated at that annoying brown box? No more worries! I am here to (minorly) save you (and myself..)

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Obviously, Download Smapi
Download Content Patcher 
Download Magical Valley Interface ( you dont.. have to but why are you here if not for that to match the ui..)
Download Love of Cooking (mod this is for)
Download Crafting Collection (mod this is for)
Download Gender Neutral (mod this is for)
Download Bigger Backpack (mod this is for)
OR
Download The Return of the Bigger Backpack

[size=4][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/size]
If you download Bigger Backpack, not the return version, LOC has full compatibilty with it! So, if you'd like to have both, there are 3 separate colors for the bigger backpack: Teal, Purple, and Magenta. Choose ONE FOLDER, and take that file and put it into your Bigger Backpack Asset Folder. One last thing, if youre using LOC, take that file for LOC and put it into your LOC folder for the assets. The backpack will match the one you picked! Enjoy :D

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Mostly worked on Love of Cooking here, The backpacks have been changed to match the ones that you purchase with the Magical Valley interface, changed the tabes and changed some other minor ui stuff
Crafting Collection, obviously just has one asset you see often (other than the question mark) , its just a small flag with a hammer on it, similar to the others in the Magical Valley UI
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Smapi, most updated.
Content Patcher, Most updated
Magical Valley Interface
Love of Cooking, most updated
Crafting Collection, most updated
Gender Neutral, most updated
Bigger Backpack, most updated
OR
The Return of the Bigger Backpack, most updated
Other than that, grab the rest of the requirements for Love of Cooking,Crafting Collection,Gender Neutral, Bigger Backpack, and Bigger Backpacks ^^
